headline: Rockwell sustains strong growth amid headwinds
summary: Rockwell Land Corp. reported a 22% increase in net income attributable to its parent, to P3.8 billion, for the first nine months of the year. Robust residential sales and a sharp rise in commercial revenues supported the growth.
why: Rockwell Land is a Philippine property developer that builds residential, commercial and mixed-use projects, so its results offer a read on the local property market.
